t1_records.text: Sir! I need the student records!

p1_fees.text: Headteacher! I've been trying to get an update about my child's fees!

a1_reports.text: Sir, we also need the school reports!

a2_which.text: Which file has the latest records?

p2_answer.text: So... are you going to answer me?

h2_feellike.text: Is running a school... supposed to feel like this?

c1_hardway.text: Sir... why are you doing all this the hard way?

t3_wait.text: Wait... you're telling me we can manage the whole school from one place?

c3_idea.text: That's the idea! MwalimuEase puts your marks, fees, timetables and reports in one dashboard.

h5_suffering.text: And I've been suffering all this time?

h7_stop.text: Stop making school management harder than it needs to be!
